VideoDownload.title: VideoDownload
VideoDownload.description: Represents a video download initiated by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the video download entry.

userId.description: Reference to the User who initiated the download. (Relationship: User 1:N VideoDownload)

videoUrl.description: The URL of the video being downloaded.

downloadedAt.description: The date and time when the download was completed.

status.description: The current status of the download (e.g., pending, in progress, completed, failed).

filePath.description: The local file path where the video is saved on the device.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Video Grabber application.

registrationDate.description: The date and time when the user registered.

active.description: Whether the subscription is currently active.

subscribedAt.description: The date and time when the user subscribed.

expiresAt.description: The date and time when the subscription expires.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a message or announcement sent to users.

content.description: The main body of the message.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the message was created.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Includes standard user information like email and registration date.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user.

definition.description: Stores video download information for each user. Includes details such as video URL, quality, download status, and file path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user.

params.name: downloadId
params.description: The unique identifier for the video download.

definition.description: Stores user subscription status. There will typically be one main subscription document per user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the subscription, e.g., 'main'.

definition.description: Stores global messages or announcements for all users.

params.name: messageId
params.description: The unique identifier for the message.
